content: स्वाभाविक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [स्वभावादागतः ढञ्] Belonging to oneʼs own nature, innate, inherent, peculiar, natural; स्वाभाविकं विनीतत्वं तेषां विनयकर्मणा . मुमूर्च्छ सहजं तेजो हविषेव हविर्भुजाम् <ls>R. 10. 79</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 69</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 71</ls>. .{@-काः@} {%m.%} <ab>pl.</ab> A sect of Buddhists who accounted for all things by the laws of nature.
